feeds.title: Edible Brooklyn
feeds.description: Edible Brooklyn celebrates the borough's diverse food and delicious culture. They're your guide to everything edible in the great borough of Brooklyn. They showcase how New York eats through their print and digital content and at events where their stories get to come to life. They celebrate the food community who are building an accessible, diverse sustainable, and damn tasty food culture.
